'''Pleth Juun''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]], who became a surgeon and joined the military.

==Biography==
Juun was born into a wealthy family on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and attended one of the world's most prestigious medical schools. She later joined the military, as a surgeon, and was given the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]]. While she was in her mid-twenties, she was present on the planet Pleida, where a conflict was being fought, and was attached to a [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] that was commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Roff Volane]]. After a number of officers were injured at the base [[Camp Kavel]], a team of agents were assigned by Volane to escort Juun there, so that she could administer treatment to the officers.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />

==Personality and traits==
Pleth Juun was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] with gray eyes and cropped dark blond hair. Due to her privileged upbringing, she had a haughty demeanor and was arrogant and vindictive. She expected her orders to obeyed and if they weren't, she perceived it as an insult. However, she was a skilled surgeon and a loyal [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]].<ref name="Galaxy at War" />

==Skills and abilities==
Juun was a gifted surgeon. She could speak [[Bocce/Legends|Bocce]], [[Cerean (language)|Cerean]], [[Durese/Legends|Durese]], [[High Galactic (language)|High Galactic]], [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]], [[Kel Dor (language)/Legends|Kel Dor]], and [[Twi'leki/Legends|Ryl]].<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
